name: Aisle
about: Aisle is a US online marketplace (fashion 45% of sales, home 30%, electronics 25%). 4,500 independent sellers; three parcel carriers deliver: Rapid Parcel 45% of orders, Meridian 35%, Dash 20%. Normal delivery 2-4 days, free shipping over $35, holiday orders from Nov 1 can be returned until Jan 31.
business_as_usual: The delivery estimate at checkout says "2-4 days".
Complaints are answered within 48 hours; claims that a product is fake go to the seller first.
Sellers choose their own carrier from the three.

known_crisis.text: News: the drivers' union at Rapid Parcel, Aisle's biggest carrier, says it will strike from December 1 if contract talks fail. The talks are not going well. Rapid Parcel says it would keep delivering with managers and temporary drivers, more slowly. Nobody knows how slow or for how long.
